additions.reason: The Torah repeatedly and explicitly equates שכל (intellect/sekhel) with נשמה (soul) as a bechina: 'כי חדוש השכל הינו חדוש הנשמה, כי השכל הוא הנשמה'. This bechina statement — 'השכל הוא הנשמה' — is the structural spine of the Torah's second section (ב). The concept שכל is used interchangeably with מחין throughout and is the substance that gets renewed by אור הפנים. It belongs in Package 2 alongside חדוש המחין and חדוש הנשמה, completing the triad: sekhel = mochin = neshamah. The absence of an explicit bechina edge for שכל ↔ נשמה in the dataset is a gap.

additions.reason: The Torah explicitly states 'ובינה לבא' (Binah = the heart/lev) and that one must draw the chasmal from the olam of Binah. Binah is identified as the source of the chasmal/protective garment: 'צריך להמשיך בחינת חשמ"ל מעולם הבינה, להלביש את המלכות'. The bechina: 'אם לבינה תקרא' — Binah is the mother who shelters her children (אמא מסככת על בנהא). This bechina connection (Binah = the protective maternal force that generates the chasmal) places Binah squarely in Package 3 alongside חשמ"ל. 'ובינה לבא' (Binah = the heart) also connects directly to 'דובר אמת בלבבו'.

additions.reason: The Torah opens with: 'תשובה היא לשוב את הדבר למקום שנטל משם, והוא בחינת זרקא'. Teshuva IS the zarqa cantillation note — the act of returning the thing to its source. The Torah then identifies that source (the 'athar' from which things were taken) as חכמה: 'ומאן ההוא אתר, הוא חכמה'. So: תשובה = זרקא = הشכינה = return to חכמה. This is a bechina of the אור הפנים package since it describes the renewal of wisdom from its source. Teshuva belongs in Package 2 as the initiating act that corresponds to the return of the soul/intellect to its divine source.

analysis_notes.note_on_package_5: Package 5 (evil wisdoms) is small (2 nodes) but is kept as independent because it is the sole evil/negative package in this Torah and the framework requires that the evil mirror be preserved as its own entity. It is structurally the counterpart of Package 2 (holy wisdom).
analysis_notes.note_on_package_4: The two merged pairs forming Package 4 have no bechina edges connecting them to the main faith cluster (Package 1) in the dataset. Although the source text makes clear that faithful commerce IS Ketoret service IS extraction of sparks, these are eitza connections (commerce produces/enables the spark elevation). The shared NATURE — 'sacred elevation of embedded holiness from klipot' — is what unites Packages D+E as one package.
